div.head: Swer 2
div.ab: Ðus man sceal swerigean, þonne man hafð his æhte gebryid 7 bringeð hi on gange. On ðone Drihten, ðe ðæs haligdom is for eh, swa ic spæce drife mid fullan folcrihte, butan bræde 7 biswice 7 butan æghwilcum facne, swa me ðeofstolen wæs þæt orf N., þæt ic onspece 7 þæt ic mid Ñ. befangen hæbbe.

Per illum Deum, pro quo sanctum hoc sanctificatum est, ita causam prosequor plena populi rectitudine, sine brede et bispice et omni facno, sicut mihi furtiuum est hoc pecus N., de quo loquor, quod cum N. deprehendi.

On ðone Drihten, þe ðes haligdom is fore halig, swa ic spæce drife mid fullan folcrihte, butan bræde 7 butan swice 7 butan æghwylcum facne, swa me forstolen wæs ðæt orf N., ðæt ic onspece 7 þæt ic mid N. befangen hæbbe.

(Folgendermassen soll man [Kläger] schwören, sobald man seine Fahrhabe [im Anefang] erfasst hat und sie in [Gewähr]zug bringt. B) Bei dem Herrn, vor welchem dies Heiligthum heilig ist, só betreib ich Klage kraft vollen Landrechtes ohne List und ohne Tücke und ohne irgend welchen Trug, wie mir dies Vieh N. diebisch gestohlen worden ist, welches ich einklage und welches ich bei N. beschlagnahmt habe.

(Thus shall one [the plaintiff] swear, once one has seized one's property [in attachment] and brings it into the [warranty] procedure. B) By the Lord before whom this relic is holy, so do I pursue my suit with full folk-right, without fraud and without deceit and without any trickery, as this cattle N. was stolen from me by theft, which I claim and which I have attached with N.

[I swear] by the Lord before whom this relic is holy, [that] I pursue this case with full justice and without deceit or fraud and without any deception since these cattle (N.) for which I bring a claim were stolen from me, and which I [consequently) seized from N.
div.note: B's ‘gebryid’ is a Middle English form; ‘for eh’ stands so without an abbreviation mark (correct to ‘fore halig’ as in 1). H reads ‘forstolen’; the Quadripartitus read ‘ðeofstolen’ (with B), better. Formula 2 is used at least in part in II As 9 (compare also 3.4 and Duns 8.1). K: ‘beswice’ corrected to ‘biswice’.
